Class TesselFileChooser

java.lang.Object
net.tessel.fx.components.TesselFileChooser
public class TesselFileChooser extends Object
A file chooser dialog in the Tessel style, with the API of FileChooser (which opens a native operating system dialog that no theme can change). 
TesselFileChooser chooser = new TesselFileChooser();
chooser.setTitle("Open picture");
chooser.getExtensionFilters().add(new FileChooser.ExtensionFilter("Images", "*.png", "*.jpg"));
File file = chooser.showOpenDialog(window);         // null when cancelled
List<File> files = chooser.showOpenMultipleDialog(window);
File target = chooser.showSaveDialog(window);       // asks before replacing an existing file
File folder = chooser.showDirectoryDialog(window);
It shows a breadcrumb address bar, a places sidebar, back / forward / up / new folder, and list, details and tile views; see FileBrowser. The dialog opens in the folder the last dialog of this chooser was closed in.
